title: Coded For The Night
style: futuristic techno, electro-pop, 120 BPM, cybernetic female vocals, subtle robotic processing, deep rolling bass, atmospheric synth pads, arpeggiated sequence, metallic percussion, gated snare, clean club mix, 80s synth textures, hypnotic mechanical groove, sensual cool, cold start intro, two-chord vamp, cinematic lens, sidechain pumping, long decay reverb futuristic techno, 120 BPM, sleek cybernetic female vocals with subtle robotic processing, deep rolling bass, atmospheric synths, hypnotic mechanical groove, sensual and cool (no aggression), clean club production, DJ Zyn g4 lens cinematic feel
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Deep pulsating sub bass + distant helicopter rotor sweep)
System… wake…
Cold start… engage.
[Verse 1]
Binary pulse running through my core
Move… sync… activate the groove
Low bass vibrating in my frame
Echoes calling out your name
[Pre-Chorus]
Reboot… reset…
Follow my frequency
[Chorus]
I am the rhythm
I am the motion
Bass control… drop… reload
Step step… locked in the beat
Step step… magnetic heat
[Hook]
Body coded for the night
Glide… repeat… mechanical heat
Body coded for the night
Glide… repeat… can’t escape the beat
[Verse 2]
Voltage rising, signals burning bright
Body wired for this digital life
Neon veins under ultraviolet
Moving flawless through the endless night
[Bridge]
(Glitchy vocal chop + rising tension)
System overload…
Let the bass take control…
[Final Chorus]
I am the rhythm
I am the motion
Bass control… drop… reload
[Outro]
Fade out… system low…
Bass memory… let it flow
Coded for the night…
